svg.aria-label: Pipeline in eight steps. 1 build a simulated web and tasks. 2 check the data with CuratorKIT. 3 teach tool use with LoRA SFT. 4 train by reward with AgentTune GRPO. 5 evaluate on held-out test sets and store every episode. 6 AuditKIT scores the stored episodes. 7 an independent LLM judge re-reads a sample; when it finds something the detector missed, the detector is fixed and step 4 runs again. 8 CircuitKIT looks inside the model at one decision.
